name: REL7-1-the-old-notes-kept
note: The old notes would stand under the new ones, "Fixes and improvements." among them.

name: REL7-2-the-list-dropped
note: GitHub's list of merged changes would be lost from the release.

name: REL7-3-crlf-read-as-is
old:
const text = String(current ?? '').replace(/\r\n/g, '\n');
  const cut = text.search(GENERATED_LIST_RE);
new:
const text = String(current ?? '');
  const cut = text.search(GENERATED_LIST_RE);
note: A body GitHub hands back with CRLF would keep its carriage returns in the list.

name: REL7-4-a-cut-of-its-own
old: export const GENERATED_LIST_RE = /^(##\s*What['’]s Changed\b|\*\*Full Changelog\*\*|##\s*New Contributors\b)/m;
note: The release's cut and the launcher's would drift apart.

name: REL7-6-a-failed-read-writes-anyway
old:
console.error(`the notes could not be read - the release is left as it is: ${String(e?.stderr || e?.message || e).trim()}`);
      return 1;
new:
console.error(`the notes could not be read - the release is left as it is: ${String(e?.stderr || e?.message || e).trim()}`);
      notes = [];
note: GitHub down: the release's notes would be written over with "Fixes and improvements.".

name: REL7-9-a-schedule-of-its-own
note: The workflow would rewrite releases on its own.

name: REL7-5-read-up-to-main
note: Run from main, a release would take the notes of every pull request merged since it.

name: REL7-7-the-tag-unchecked
note: A tag carrying quotes or a newline would reach the API.

name: REL7-8-a-text-sort
note: app-v0.1.10 sorts before app-v0.1.9 as text: an edit would rewrite a later release than the one that brought the pull request.

name: REL7-10-the-tag-is-its-own-previous
note: The release would read the merges since itself - none - and write "Fixes and improvements." over its notes.

name: REL7-11-an-open-pull-request-too
note: Every edit to an open pull request's description would rewrite a release.

name: REL7-12-no-tag-writes-anyway
old: try { git(['rev-parse', '--verify', '--quiet', `refs/tags/${a}^{commit}`]); } catch { throw new Error(`no tag ${a} in this checkout`); }
note: A tag the checkout lacks reads as no previous release, and "Fixes and improvements." is written over the notes.

name: REL7-13-the-pull-request-s-code
note: pull_request_target would run a pull request's own code under a token that writes releases.

name: REL7-14-no-release-yet-fails
old:
echo "no release carries #$PR yet - the next one reads its description as it is"
              exit 0
new:
echo "no release carries #$PR yet - the next one reads its description as it is"
              exit 1
note: An edit before the release is cut would fail a run for nothing.

name: REL7-15-write-with-no-release
old:
- name: Write the notes again
        if: steps.release.outputs.tag != ''
note: With no release to write, the step would ask GitHub for an empty tag and fail.
